name: id_cnpj
description: Issuer CNPJ, digits only, padded to 14.

name: data_referencia
description: Reference date of the FCA filing.

name: id_documento
description: FCA document id. Floor later keeps the latest per (CNPJ, ticker).

name: razao_social
description: Issuer legal name on the FCA.

name: ticker
description: B3 trading code. Joins COTAHIST CODNEG.

name: composicao_bdr_unit
description: BDR/unit composition when the security is a unit.

name: tipo_mercado
description: Market (Bolsa / Balcão). Floor later keeps Bolsa.

name: data_fim_negociacao
description: Last trading date. Empty means still listed.
